remediation_note: Version 3.0.0 remediates PREPRINT-28 v2.0.0 through the generalized declarative bio-suite pipeline: (1) replaced truncated Stage 4 FAM-04 CYP3A records (previously 1/12 I-helix, 0/12 Cys-loop) with 14 verified full-length Mollusca/Polyplacophora CYP3A mRNAs retaining 12/12 conserved I-helix and FxxGxxxCxG Cys-loop heme-thiolate motifs threaded onto PDB 1TQN, and ordered soma/heavy Ferritins ahead of oocyte Ferritins in FAM-01; (2) isolated Cohort L6 to single-compartment Chitonida 16S rRNA (acantho_pop_l6_16s_v3) purging cached Liolophura CYP3A contamination and converged all 12 skylines at minESS >= 200 and maxRhat <= 1.05; (3) disambiguated F:T044 (Acanthochitona sp. Adriatic) and G:T060 (Acanthochitona sp. IWP); and (4) activated acanthochitonidae_preprint28_design.json clade recovery evaluation plus metadata hygiene.

manuscript_prose.section1_title: Convergent Valve Burial, 18-Tuft Spicule Armor & Trans-Oceanic Rafting Across Acanthochitonidae and Polyplacophora
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Polyplacophoran mollusks (chitons) pair eight articulated aragonite shell valves with a muscular spicule-armored girdle, magnetite-capped radular teeth capable of scraping coralline rock, and innervated sensory esthetes including image-forming shell eyes in Chitonidae. Within Suborder Acanthochitonina, dorsal valve reduction and full epithelial valve burial evolved independently in Giant Gumboot Chiton Cryptochiton stelleri (Mopalioidea) and in Australasian/New Zealand Cryptoconchus lineages (Cryptoplacoidea).
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In v3.0.0, all 64 Polyplacophora OTUs ([A]-[G]) with disambiguated Adriatic (F:T044) and Indo-West Pacific (G:T060) Acanthochitona slots execute through the generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor pipeline with Edge-Linked Partitioned ModelTest vs. Unpartitioned ML estimator parity, acanthochitonidae_preprint28_design.json clade recovery validation, single-compartment Chitonida 16S rRNA in Cohort L6 (acantho_pop_l6_16s_v3), and full-length CYP3A orthologs preserving 12/12 I-helix and Cys-loop heme-thiolate geometry on PDB 1TQN.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: Autonomous Hygiene, >=80% Supermatrix Coverage Gate, Mitogenome Phasing & Chronology
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 64-Species Quartet Multispecies Coalescent Tree, ABBA-BABA & 32-Chain RuNIE Audit
manuscript_prose.section4_title: 61-State Codon Selection on Magnetite Radula Ferritins, Aragonite Spicule alpha-CA, HSPA12 & 1TQN CYP3A
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across 48 verified Universal Standard Code 1 nuclear coding orthologs, Goldman-Yang 61-state codon models resolve ferroxidase constraint across soma/heavy-anchored magnetite radular Ferritins (FAM-01), dorsal valve and 18-tuft spicule alpha-carbonic anhydrases (FAM-02), intertidal desiccation chaperones (FAM-03: HSPA12A/12B), and full-length benthic allelochemical detoxification CYP3A monooxygenases (FAM-04) threaded onto PDB 1TQN (2.05 A) with 12/12 I-helix and proximal Cys442 FxxGxxxCxG heme-thiolate coordination.
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Cross-Regional vs. Multi-Locus Skylines (18S/28S/H3/16S) & Stage 3C JTMD Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Re-executing Class Polyplacophora and Family Acanthochitonidae through the generalized declarative bio-suite pipeline cleanly separates ancient Lepidopleurida-Chitonida-Acanthochitonina divergences from Neogene-Quaternary marginal-sea connectivity and Anthropocene trans-Pacific dispersal.

Replacing legacy truncated CYP3A transcripts with 14 verified full-length Mollusca/Polyplacophora CYP3A mRNAs restored 12/12 I-helix and Cys-loop motif fidelity on 1TQN, while isolating Cohort L6 to pure Chitonida 16S rRNA resolved all 12 coalescent skylines cleanly at minESS >= 200 and maxRhat <= 1.05.

Paired evaluation against acanthochitonidae_preprint28_design.json, 64-species Quartet MSC, ABBA-BABA introgression tests, and Stage 3C TCS/MSN haplotype graphs provides a reproducible baseline across benthic molluscan biomineralization and coastal biogeography.
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Sixty-four Polyplacophora taxa spanning Lepidopleurida outgroups [A], Chitonina [B], Mopalioidea [C], Cryptoplacidae [D], basal Acanthochitonidae [E], Atlanto-American Acanthochitona [F], and NW/Indo-West Pacific Acanthochitona [G] are evaluated across 17 loci and 4 biomineralization/detoxification families in Version 3.0.0.
